items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: this man, Johnny Lindsay and myself, see -- see, we joined Louie. I joined Louie in Detroit -- Johnny Lindsay and myself.

ctx.x: Now, to really to get your -- to get the record straight about -- now, this band -- I joined Louie starting in Detroit. I made a jump out here -- this man, Johnny Lindsay and myself, see -- see, we joined Louie. I'll tell you why I'm sitting over there after awhile and not sitting here. I joined Louie in Detroit -- Johnny Lindsay and myself. The first night we opened up at the Greystone Ballroom -- I mean

Lindsay and myself opened up with Louie at the Greystone Ballroom Louie played up to a certain time, then he took a rest -- intermission. I always make a habit, when I take intermission and come back on the bandstand, say about five minutes before they hit -- ten minues, so I can just go back there and sit down. I don't really have to go -- back there and sit down, and when I went back, Louie hollered at me, "Hey Randy," and I says, "Yes." He said, "Pick you out a set and take it down. Now, this is your band."
